# AP Reset Scroll

*Moves one ability point from STR to DEX. It cannot take back what you started with.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Type | Consumable |
| Effect | Moves an ability point from STR to DEX |
| Sells for | 100 mesos |

## How to get

- Dropped by [Orange Mushroom](../monsters/orange_mushroom.md) (0.15%)
- Dropped by [Pig](../monsters/pig.md) (0.15%)
